type Literal<V extends {a: {length: number}}> = V['a']['length'];
type Bounded<V extends {a: {length: number}}, K extends 'a'> = V[K]['length'];
type Both<V extends {a: {length: number}; b: {length: number}}, K extends 'a' | 'b'> = V[K]['length'];
type KeyOfValue<V, K extends keyof V, P extends keyof V[K]> = V[K][P];
type SameValue<V, K extends keyof V> = V[K][keyof V[K]];
type IndexedNext<V extends {a: {length: number}; b: 'length'}> = V['a'][V['b']];
type NarrowKey<V extends {a: {length: number}}, K extends keyof V> = K extends 'a' ? V[K]['length'] : never;
type Rest<V extends [{length: number}, ...{length: number}[]]> = V[number]['length'];
type Choice<V extends {a: {length: number}}, K extends keyof V> =
  V[K] extends {length: number} ? V[K]['length'] : never;
type Correlated<V, K extends keyof V, T extends {selected: keyof V[K]}> = V[K][T['selected']];
type KnownRecord<V, K extends keyof V, T extends Record<string, keyof V[K]>, P extends keyof T> = V[K][T[P]];
type ExactIndexedKey<V extends {a: {length: number}}, K extends 'a'> = V[K][keyof V['a']];
type NarrowedKey<V, K extends keyof V, T, P extends keyof T> = T[P] extends keyof V[K] ? V[K][T[P]] : never;
type StringRecord<V extends Record<string, {length: number}>, K extends keyof V> = V[K]['length'];
const value: KeyOfValue<{a: {length: number}}, 'a', 'length'> = 5;
console.log(value);
